entity.summary: Self-custody mobile cryptocurrency wallet lineage that began as Airbitz in 2014 and later rebranded to Edge.
entity.notes: Edge preserves the Airbitz wallet lineage. First-party material states that the original open-source Airbitz Bitcoin wallet launched in early 2014 and the Edge Wallet product launched publicly in 2018.

products.summary: Edge's multi-asset mobile self-custody wallet, launched as the successor product to the earlier Airbitz wallet lineage.
products.notes: First-party launch announcement states that Edge Wallet became publicly available on iOS and Android on 2018-02-15.

events.title: Airbitz announced its rebrand to Edge
events.description: Airbitz announced that the wallet company and platform were becoming Edge while carrying the existing client-side security and wallet lineage into the new brand.
events.notes: This is an entity/product-lineage rebrand event, not the public launch date of the later Edge Wallet release.

events.title: Edge Wallet launched direct Revolut integration
events.description: Edge announced on 2025-09-02 that the wallet added a direct Revolut integration for buying crypto into the self-custody wallet and selling crypto back to a user's Revolut account without an additional intermediary account.

evidence.title: Why Edge is Open Source
evidence.notes: First-party Edge history states that its founders launched the open-source Airbitz Bitcoin wallet in early 2014, establishing the entity lineage.

evidence.title: Edge Wallet Is LIVE!!
evidence.notes: First-party launch post states that Edge Wallet became publicly available for download on iOS and Android on 2018-02-15.

evidence.title: Airbitz is now Edge!
evidence.notes: First-party Edge announcement explicitly states that Airbitz is now Edge while carrying forward the company's client-side security platform and wallet lineage.

evidence.title: Edge Launches Direct Revolut Integration
evidence.notes: First-party Edge announcement for a live wallet integration.
